lines.text: She always sits front, always smiles!

data.define: A student who gets special favor from the teacher.

misuse.text: Don't call a classmate 'teacher's pet' to her face.

hook.text: She always sits front, always smiles!

publish.title: What does "teacher's pet" mean?
publish.value: Teacher's pet = The teacher's favorite student. Example: "Sam is the teacher's pet." (casual English).
